g.text: Rental step 13 · Renter: check the release record (before)
Self-drive rental, step by step (renter, owner and administrator)

text.tspan: At release: 52,310 km · fuel 3/4 · Small scratch on rear bumper; spare tire, jack and early warning device included
Waiting for the renter to confirm this record.
Odometer 52,310 km · fuel 3/4 · Small scratch on rear bumper; spare tire, jack and early warning device included. Compare it with the photos above.
Your answer protects you if there is a damage claim later.
What is different? e.g. fuel was 3/4, not full
Your contract asks you to share your location while you drive the rented vehicle. Turn it on before you leave the pickup.
Rental ₱5,400.00 + deposit ₱5,000.00 · Verified paid ₱0.00 · ₱5,000.00 waiting for cashier ·
Read the contract and sign it here before pickup, or sign the printed copy the owner brings. The vehicle can only be released once it is signed.
Pay the full ₱10,400.00 before pickup. The first ₱5,000.00 goes to the deposit. GCash is simulated in this prototype; a cashier verifies each payment.
